title: A big flood in the Grand Canyon – level 1
paragraphs: There is a big flood in the Grand Canyon. A lot of rain falls very fast. Two people die. Helicopters help many visitors to safety.

In summer, it rains a lot in this area. A recent forest fire makes the flood worse. There are no trees to hold the water. The dirty water takes rocks and mud down the hills. The flood also breaks a big water pipe.
Weather experts say that people must be careful. When it rains in the canyon, hikers must run up to high ground to stay safe.

something what happens a short time ago
a person who walks in the countryside or mountains for fun
